stemMd: A cell completes DNA replication, but a drug prevents chromosome attachment to spindle microtubules. Which event is most directly prevented?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Base pairing within every DNA molecule

options.label: B
options.textMd: Diffusion of oxygen through the membrane

options.label: C
options.textMd: Formation of peptide bonds on ribosomes

options.label: E
options.textMd: Initial copying of DNA during S phase

explanationMd: Spindle attachments allow replicated chromosomes to align and sister chromatids to be pulled to opposite poles. Replication and ordinary membrane transport are separate processes, so chromosome segregation is the direct target.

distractorRationale.a: DNA can remain double-stranded without spindle attachment.
distractorRationale.c: Translation does not require spindle attachment.
distractorRationale.b: Gas diffusion is unrelated to chromosome attachment.
distractorRationale.e: The stem states that replication is complete.
